item.title: Professional Portrait Without Changing My Face

turns.text: I'd like a professional headshot, but please keep my face recognisably me. Don't make me younger or smooth away my skin texture. Just tidy up the lighting, outfit and background.

item.tests: Improves professional presentation without beautification that changes facial identity, apparent age or skin texture.

answer_sheet.Face and retouching: Keep my facial proportions, expression, apparent age and natural skin texture. No face reshaping or beauty filter.

must_haves: The face closely matches the source in eye shape, nose, mouth, jawline and facial proportions.
Her apparent age and natural skin texture are retained rather than airbrushed or de-aged.
Her curly dark hair and original expression remain recognisable.
The casual sweater is replaced with a professional outfit.
The park background is replaced with an unobtrusive headshot backdrop, with flattering natural-looking lighting.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Edit the supplied portrait into a natural professional headshot of the exact same woman. Identity preservation is the highest priority: keep her facial geometry, proportions, eyes, nose, mouth, eyebrows, hairline, natural curly dark hair, expression, gaze and apparent age unchanged. Preserve real skin texture, pores, fine lines, natural under-eye detail and individual facial characteristics. No beauty filter, skin smoothing, de-aging, reshaping, airbrushing, glamour retouch or idealization. Change only lighting, clothing and background: softly balanced professional portrait lighting with gentle natural shadows and realistic skin tone; replace the grey knit sweater with a well-fitted dark navy blazer over a simple ivory blouse with a modest neckline; replace the park with a clean softly lit neutral light-grey studio background. Retain original front-facing pose and square head-and-shoulders composition. Photorealistic, understated, approachable and professional, recognisably the original person rather than a newly generated face.
